content.title: When do NHL playoffs start? 2026 standings, bracket with East series set
content.text: April 14, 2026Updated April 15, 2026, 7:09 a.m. ETAll 16 NHL playoff berths are filled with three days left in the regular season and more playoff series have been set.The Eastern Conference first round series are official after the Boston Bruins won 4-0 to clinch the first wild-card seed.The Carolina Hurricanes will face the Ottawa Senators, the Buffalo Sabres will play the Bruins and the other two series are Tampa Bay Lightning vs. Montreal Canadiens and Pittsburgh Penguins vs. Philadelphia Flyers.The Utah Mammoth clinched the top wild-card seed in the West on Tuesday, but the Pacific Division seeds won't be decided until later in the week.The most-anticipated game had no playoff implications as Washington Capitals star Alex Ovechkin skated off a 2-1 winner in his season finale. The NHL's all-time leading scorer hasn't said whether he'll return for another season. He faced the Columbus Blue Jackets, the team against which he scored two goals in his NHL debut in 2005. He picked up an assist on the winning goal."I hope it's not my last game," he told reporters. "I don't know what's going to happen. We'll see."Here's what to know about the NHL standings, including the latest playoff bracket and the tiebreaker procedures for the 2025-26 season before the postseason begins on April 18: Canucks beat Kings: What it meansVancouver wins 4-3 in overtime. The Kings' loss keeps them in the second wild-card spot and allows the Mammoth to clinch the first wild card. Utah will face the Pacific Division winner in the first round. Los Angeles can still reach third in the Pacific if it picks up one more point than Anaheim in the teams' season finales. As things stand on Tuesday, the Kings would face the No. 1 overall Avalanche. Mammoth beat Jets: What it meansThe Mammoth do their part in their bid to clinch the first wild-card seed in the West, though they will need the Kings to lose. Wild beat Ducks: What it meansAnaheim's 3-2 regulation loss means it doesn't advance in the Pacific Division race and could possibly drop. The Ducks stay at 90 points and the Kings (89) and Mammoth (90) are in action. If both win, Anaheim would drop to the second wild card, meaning a first round matchup against the Avalanche. The Ducks' loss also means the Golden Knights can finish no lower than second in the Pacific, meaning home ice advantage in the first round. Hurricanes beat Islanders: What it meansCarolina's 2-1 win gives them 113 points. The Hurricanes will have home-ice through the playoffs unless they face the Colorado Avalanche in the Stanley Cup Final. Islanders standout rookie Matthew Schaefer was held without a point. He finishes with a record-tying 23 goals by a rookie defenseman, matching Brian Leetch's mark. Flyers beat Canadiens: What it meansMontreal's 4-2 loss locks them in at third place in the Atlantic Division. The Canadiens will open on the road at Tampa. The Flyers will open in Pittsburgh. Bruins beat Devils: What it meansBoston's 4-0 victory gives them the first wild-card seed in the East. They will face the Sabres in the first round and the Hurricanes will face the Senators. The other series are Flyers-Penguins and Canadiens-Lightning. Alex Ovechkin leaves the ice a winnerIf this is Alex Ovechkin's final NHL game, he leaves the ice a winner, 2-1 against the Blue Jackets. He drew an assist on the game winning and finishes with a record 929 goals, 758 assists and 1,687 points in 1,753 career games. He played all 82 games this season and led the Capitals with 32 goals and 64 points at age 40.He high-fived his teammates as he went off the ice, clapped his hands to acknowledge fans chanting, "Ovi, Ovi," and then skated directly to the dressing room. Ovechkin says he will talk to his family and the team in the offseason and he decides whether to retire or come back for a 22nd season. Blue Jackets pull goalieAlex Ovechkin shoots wide of the open net as the puck rolls on him. Fans chanting, "Ovi." Capitals score on power playMiles Wood is called for high-sticking. Alex Ovechkin gets off a few shots. Jakob Chychrun scores to give the Capitals a 2-1 lead. Ovechkin gets an assist. That's No. 758 for his career. Ducks, Wild tied after one periodScore is 1-1. The Ducks can move into second place in the Pacific Division if they win. Capitals go on power playAlex Ovechkin is in his office in the left faceoff circle. He moves closer to the net and gets off a shot, but Columbus kills that penalty, too. Alex Ovechkin, Capitals start third periodThe Capitals are on the power play. Blue Jackets kill it off. Canadiens trail Flyers after two periodsMatvei Michkov gave the Flyers a 3-1 lead with his 20th goal of the season, but Jake Evans scored with 11 seconds left in the second period to make it 3-2. If Montreal loses in regulation, Tampa Bay gets home ice in their upcoming first round series. Bruins have big lead after two periodsBoston is 4-0 against New Jersey. They clinch the first wild card in the Eastern Conference with a victory. Capitals, Blue Jackets tied after two periodsColumbus' Boone Jenner and Washington's Anthony Beauvillier scored in the period for a 1-1 tie. Alex Ovechkin has one shot and the Capitals will be on the power play to start the third period. Canadiens get one goal backBrendan Gallagher cuts the Flyers' lead to 2-1. Montreal needs at least one point in this game to have a chance at home ice in their first round series against Tampa Bay. Second period underway in ColumbusWashington-Columbus was scoreless, but Boone Jenner just put the Blue Jackets up 1-0. Washington's Alex Ovechkin, who hasn't decided whether this is his last season, had no shots and one hit in the first period. Flyers lead Canadiens after oneIt's 2-0 with Philadelphia goals from Porter Martone and Oliver Bonk. If the Canadiens lose, the Lightning clinch second in the Atlantic Division and home ice in the Tampa Bay-Montreal first round series.Bruins take big leadBoston has a 4-0 lead after one period against the Devils. Mark Kastelic has scored twice and Morgan Geekie has scored his 39th goal and Viktor Arvidsson his 25th. If this keeps up, the Bruins clinch the first wild-card seed and a first round matchup with the Buffalo Sabres.TJ Oshie interview with Alex OvechkinWho's in the 2026 NHL playoffs?Eastern Conference: Carolina, Pittsburgh, Philadelphia, Buffalo, Montreal, Tampa Bay, Boston, OttawaWestern Conference: Colorado, Dallas, Minnesota, Vegas, Edmonton, Anaheim, Utah, Los AngelesWho can clinch an NHL playoff seed today?The Bruins will clinch the first wild card in the East if they beat the New Jersey Devils. That would set up a first round meeting with the Sabres. The Ottawa Senators would face the Carolina Hurricanes. Update: The Bruins won and clinched the first wild card.The idle Lightning will clinch second in the Atlantic Division and home-ice advantage in the first round if the Montreal Canadiens lose in regulation. Update: The Canadiens lost to the Flyers and start the first round series at Tampa Bay.The Mammoth will clinch the first wild card in the West if they beat the Winnipeg Jets and the Los Angeles Kings lose. They'd also clinch if they get one point and the Kings lose in regulation. Utah would face the Pacific Division winner in the first round.The Kings would finish as the second wild card if they lose in regulation and the Anaheim Ducks and Mammoth pick up at least one point. The Kings would face the Colorado Avalanche in the first round. WC - wild cardNHL tiebreakers: What is the first tiebreaker in NHL standings?If two teams are tied in points at the end of the regular season, here are the tiebreakers:Regulation winsRegulation and overtime wins (ROW)Total winsMost points earned in head-to-head competition: If teams had an uneven number of meetings, the first game played in the city that has the extra game is excluded. When more than two clubs are tied, the percentage of available points earned in games among each other (and not including any odd games) shall be used to determine standings.Goal differentialTotal goalsWhen does the NHL regular season end?The NHL regular season is scheduled to end on Thursday, April 16, with six games.When do the NHL playoffs start?The NHL's Stanley Cup playoffs are scheduled to begin on Saturday, April 18.
